usage: Prevents symptoms of asthma like wheezing and shortness of breath.
dosage: 1-2 puffs twice daily or as directed. Use regularly even when symptoms are absent. Consult a professional.
warnings: Rinse mouth with water after each use to prevent thrush.
Not for immediate relief of sudden asthma attacks.
storage: Keep away from direct heat and sunlight. Store below 30°C.

usage: Long-term treatment of asthma and COPD.
dosage: Usually 2 puffs twice daily. Consult your physician.
warnings: Use regularly to maintain control.
Report any worsening of breathing to a doctor immediately.
storage: Store in a cool place. Do not freeze.

usage: Treats bacterial infections of lungs, throat, skin, and urinary tract.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet twice daily for 5-14 days. Complete the course.
warnings: Caution if allergic to Penicillin.
Monitor for signs of liver or kidney problems.
storage: Store in a dry place below 25°C.

usage: Treats fungal skin infections like athlete's foot and ringworm.
dosage: Apply once daily to the affected area for 1-2 weeks. Consult a doctor.
warnings: External use only.
Avoid contact with eyes and mouth.
storage: Keep the tube tightly closed. Store at room temperature.

usage: Antifungal powder used for skin infections, sweat rash, and prickly heat.
dosage: Dust the powder over the affected area 2-3 times daily. Seek professional advice.
warnings: Maintain dryness in the affected area.
Consult doctor if condition doesn't improve in 2 weeks.

usage: Ayurvedic syrup for relief from cough and throat irritation.
dosage: Adults: 2 teaspoonfuls 3-4 times a day. Children: 1 teaspoonful 3-4 times a day.
warnings: Shake well before use.
Consult doctor if cough is persistent or chronic.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Used as a laxative for temporary relief of constipation.
dosage: Adults: 1/2 to 1 tablespoonful at bedtime with water. Follow physician's advice.
warnings: Do not use for more than a week without medical advice.
Consult doctor if pregnancy or breastfeeding.
storage: Store in a cool place away from direct light.

usage: Used to treat chronic constipation and hepatic encephalopathy.
dosage: Starting dose usually 15-45 ml daily. Consult your doctor for maintenance dose.
warnings: Avoid in patients with galactosemia.
Monitor blood sugar in diabetic patients.

usage: Treats nerve pain (neuropathic pain) and vitamin B12 deficiency.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily as directed by your doctor.
warnings: Avoid alcohol as it increases sleepiness.
Inform doctor if you have kidney disease.

usage: Used for treatment of chronic pain caused by nerve damage due to diabetes or shingles.
dosage: Usually once daily at bedtime. Follow your physician's prescription.
warnings: May cause suicidal thoughts in some patients.
Do not stop abruptly to avoid withdrawal symptoms.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections of the lungs, skin, and urinary tract.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet twice daily for 5-10 days. Consult a healthcare professional.
warnings: Risk of tendon rupture, especially in older adults.
Avoid exposure to sunlight (photosensitivity).

usage: Combination antibiotic used to treat diarrhea and dysentery of amoebic or bacterial origin.
dosage: One tablet twice daily for 3-5 days. Seek professional advice.
warnings: Finish full course to avoid recurrence.
Avoid alcohol during and for 3 days after treatment.

manufacturer: J B Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Ltd
usage: Used to treat infections caused by bacteria or parasites in the stomach, liver, and skin.
dosage: Commonly 400 mg thrice daily for 5-7 days. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Strictly avoid alcohol while taking this medicine.
Finish the course completely.

usage: Antibiotic used for treating infections of respiratory tract, urinary tract, and bone/joints.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet twice daily after food. Follow doctor's orders.
warnings: Check for Penicillin allergy before use.
Maintain adequate fluid intake.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

usage: Used to treat symptoms of mild to moderate dementia in Alzheimer's disease.
dosage: Usually one tablet at bedtime. Consult your physician.
warnings: Monitor heart rate for bradycardia.
Use caution in patients with asthma or COPD.

usage: ACE inhibitor used to treat high blood pressure and reduce risk of heart failure.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily. Consult your doctor for specific dosage.
warnings: May cause a persistent dry cough.
Monitor potassium levels and kidney function.

usage: Used to treat high blood pressure and protect kidneys in diabetic patients.
dosage: Usually once daily at the same time. Consult a healthcare provider.
warnings: Not for use in pregnancy.
Monitor blood pressure regularly.

usage: Combination therapy for Type 2 diabetes to control high blood sugar.
dosage: Usually once or twice daily with meals as prescribed. Consult a professional.
warnings: Risk of low blood sugar; carry glucose.
Maintain regular meal timings.

usage: Used along with diet and exercise to lower blood sugar in Type 2 diabetes.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Notify doctor of any history of pancreatitis.
Monitor kidney function.

usage: Replaces thyroid hormone in patients with hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid).
dosage: Usually once daily in the morning on an empty stomach. Consult a physician.
warnings: Requires regular blood tests (TSH) for dosage adjustment.
Inform doctor of heart issues.
storage: Keep in the original pack to protect from light.

usage: Hormone replacement for patients with an underactive thyroid gland.
dosage: One tablet daily before breakfast as directed. Consult a professional.
warnings: Do not change brands without medical advice.
Monitor thyroid function tests periodically.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Used for treatment of nutritional deficiencies and nerve pain.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily after meals. Follow doctor's prescription.
warnings: Monitor for any allergic reactions.
Inform doctor of history of seizures.

usage: High-dose Vitamin D supplement to treat severe deficiency and maintain bone health.
dosage: Usually one sachet once a week for 8-12 weeks. Dissolve in milk or water. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Do not exceed the weekly dose.
Inform doctor of kidney stones or high calcium levels.

usage: Ayurvedic liver tonic to improve appetite and support liver function.
dosage: Adults: 2-3 teaspoonfuls thrice daily. Children: 1 teaspoonful thrice daily.
sideEffects: Generally safe when taken as directed
warnings: Shake well before use.
Consult doctor if jaundice symptoms persist.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Antibiotic for bacterial infections of throat, sinus, ear, urinary tract, and lungs.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet twice daily for 7-10 days. Follow physician's advice.
warnings: Inform doctor of any history of kidney disease.
Do not skip doses; complete the course.
